newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $2.2 bln for this week.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $2.2 bln for this week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for this week are expected to total $2.2 billion in 104 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.6 billion in 54 sales, with a $160 million Philadelphia School District deal through Merrill Lynch & Co. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 50 sales totaling $618 million are on the schedule. A $200 million New York City deal on Tuesday is the largest.
An additional 14 sales totaling $622 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues this week depending on market conditions.
